advisory.finding: The new PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES / PLAN_REVIEW_REVIEWED_TYPES constants and the added `get_args` import are hand-written into src/rebar/types.py, which is a fully GENERATED file: rebar.schemas.gen_types.render()/generate() produces the entire file content from JSON schemas and main() writes it via target.write_text(text), preserving no hand edits. The generator does not emit these constants, so the committed file no longer equals the generator output.
advisory.suggested_fix: Place the two constants in a small non-generated leaf module (e.g. rebar._types_ext or rebar.plan_review_types) that imports TicketType from rebar.types, and import them from there; or extend gen_types.py to append these declarations deterministically.

Docstring line 59-60: 'Simulated rather than actually extending the Literal' — the production derivation `frozenset(get_args(TicketType)) - PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES` (src/rebar/types.py:42-44) is never re-run with the eighth member, so a broken (e.g. hard-coded) reviewed set would still satisfy this assertion

ABSENCE: no assertion drives the actual `get_args(TicketType)`-based derivation with an added member; the check re-derives the answer with the same set-subtraction the test itself performs, so it is convergent with, not a driver of, the production path
advisory.finding: test_an_eighth_ticket_type_would_be_unaccounted_for cannot detect the regression it claims to guard (AC3). It does not actually extend TicketType and re-evaluate the production derivation `frozenset(get_args(TicketType)) - PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES`; instead it computes `extended = set(get_args(TicketType)) | {'proposal'}` and asserts `extended - PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES - PLAN_REVIEW_REVIEWED_TYPES == {'proposal'}`. Because 'proposal' is, by construction, absent from both frozensets, the assertion is trivially true for any values of the two sets — including a broken/hard-coded reviewed set. The test would remain green if the complement stopped being derived from TicketType, so it does not exercise the 'new member lands in neither set' invariant it documents.
scenarios: A maintainer re-types PLAN_REVIEW_REVIEWED_TYPES as a hard-coded literal that drifts from TicketType; this test still passes because 'proposal' is not in the literal either.
